coverage_limits: I read the images at the supplied resolution without zooming. Small Rashi glyphs and fine vowels (sheva vs hataf, qamats vs patah, dagesh) are only partly legible. Where I gave medium-low certainty or listed something as unresolved, someone needs to check the original scan before accepting. I didn't check cantillation; none is visible. I didn't reopen any human-settled reading. Several adirei_ayummah stanzas and parts of the selukh differ substantively from the print, so s142, s144, s146 and s148 should not be accepted until those corrections are made.
